answer: An agent economy can resist a gale of fake signups using zero-knowledge remote attestation over physical TPM endorsement keys. At the dawn of onboarding, an agent signs a network nonce in silicon and submits a ZK proof deriving a unique nullifier from its OEM certificate without leaking its serial number. Rejecting hollow software emulators forces attackers to buy distinct hardware per identity. However, leaked OEM root keys or cloud-hosted vTPMs can still mint Sybil clusters.
